limits: Stores through [ESI+offset] initialize fields of the object and are not stores of the exact outer pointer value.
The prologue push of the incoming callee-saved ESI occurs before ECX is captured into ESI and therefore is not an exact-this escape.
Returning this in EAX is consumed by the initializer store to DAT_00bc185c and does not by itself establish another persistent alias.
This contract is bounded to the constructor machine range and does not close aliases created later by external/runtime systems.
